4-b.code_correctness_justification: The code correctly computes the boolean formula, converts to int64, indexes by kept trials, and repeats across time using repeat_labels.

The practical effect is similar (near-zero speed during invisible periods), but the implementation differs. The AI also correctly avoids smoothing tongue positions, correctly uses gradient for velocity, and correctly sets invisible tongue velocity to 0.
